label: FGFR2::ETV6

sections.text: FGFR2 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase.
ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.

The fusion preserves the FGFR2 kinase region while altering its carboxy-terminal regulatory architecture; partner-mediated self-association can sustain FGFR signaling. FGFR2::ETV6 was detected in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
Futibatinib is US-approved for adults with previously treated, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring an FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement.
